headline: ONS survey reports AI use among UK businesses in September 2026
summary: The UK Office for National Statistics reports that 30% of businesses said they used at least one AI technology in September 2026 in Wave 165 of its Business Insights and Conditions Survey. The voluntary survey had 9,933 responses from 38,592 sampled businesses and remains official statistics in development. This is a self-reported adoption estimate; it does not measure productivity, causal impact, or economy-wide effects. The multi-year trend and large-business subgroup are excluded from this account because comparability was not reconciled and the bulletin gives conflicting subgroup thresholds.
